query: Please implement a website for visualizing epidemic data to display related information. The website should have functionalities for data display, automatic updates, and real-time tracking. Users should be able to browse epidemic data, view the latest news, and track the epidemic situation in real-time. The website should include various charts and maps to display different dimensions of epidemic data. Set primary background to light goldenrod yellow and elements to olive drab.
